**1.3.** Cancellation conditions may vary depending on how far in advance the cancellation is made.

**2.1. General Provisions on Refunds and Third-Party Expenses:**
In the event of cancellation, refunds will be calculated on the net amount effectively received by the Platform, after deducting the expenses derived from services provided by third parties outside of it. Third-party expenses include, among others:

list: Payment gateway commissions;
Banking costs;
Financial withholdings;
Charges for processing electronic payments (card, transfer, QR or other means).

This criterion will be applied uniformly to all foreseen cancellation policies.

items.text: **3.1.** The Platform establishes a single, standard cancellation policy applicable to all reservations, unless expressly stated otherwise.
**3.2.** The User acknowledges that this Policy:

list: Is informed prior to the confirmation of the reservation;
Forms an integral part of the agreement reached with the Host;
Is binding from the moment of acceptance.

sections.title: 4. CANCELLATION WITH EQUAL OR MORE THAN FIVE (5) DAYS' NOTICE

items.text: **4.1.** The User may cancel the reservation with an advance equal to or greater than five (5) calendar days regarding the scheduled check-in date.
**4.2.** For the purposes of this policy, the period will be computed from the exact date and time the cancellation is confirmed within the Platform.
**4.3.** In this scenario, the User will have the right to:

**4.3.1.** Full refund of the net reservation amount, in accordance with section 6.1, after deducting the corresponding costs for services provided by third parties.
The user acknowledges and accepts that:

list: The refund will not include financial costs, bank commissions or payment processing charges;
The cancellation request must be made exclusively through the Platform, external communications not being valid;
The cancellation will automatically free up the Host's calendar, allowing the property to be available for new reservations.
Likewise, the platform may record the cancellation for internal control purposes, User behavior evaluation and application of responsible use policies.

sections.title: 5. CANCELLATION BY THE HOST WITHIN FIVE (5) DAYS PRIOR TO CHECK-IN

items.text: **5.1.** In the event that the Host cancels a confirmed reservation within five (5) calendar days prior to the check-in date, such conduct will be considered a serious breach of their obligations within the platform.
**5.2.** Consequently, this action may lead to the application of one or more of the following measures, at the sole discretion of the platform:

list: a) The imposition of an economic penalty equivalent to twenty percent (20%) of the total reservation amount, which will be charged to the Host by deduction in the next reservation managed through the Platform or by other means stipulated in the Terms and Conditions.
b) Affectation of the Host's visibility, positioning or status within the platform.
c) Temporary account suspension.
d) Cancellation or blocking of future reservations.
e) Permanent expulsion from the platform in cases of recidivism or severity.

items.text: **5.3.** Furthermore, the Host acknowledges and accepts that they will be responsible for any damages such cancellation may cause to the guest, without prejudice to the actions that correspond directly between the parties in accordance with applicable regulations.
**5.4.** The platform reserves the right to adopt additional measures aimed at mitigating the effects of the cancellation, including relocating the guest to alternative accommodations, when possible.

sections.title: 6. CANCELLATION BY THE GUEST WITHIN FIVE (5) DAYS PRIOR TO CHECK-IN

items.text: **6.1.** When the guest cancels the reservation within 5 calendar days prior to the check-in date, it will be considered a late cancellation.
**6.2.** In this case, the guest will not be entitled to any refund, losing the right to the return of the paid amount.
**6.3.** Consequently:

list: The total reservation amount may be retained by the Platform;
Said amount will be destined for the host as compensation for the late cancellation

items.text: **6.4.** The late cancellation will be recorded by the Platform and may be considered for:

list: The evaluation of the User's commitment;
The application of preventive or restrictive measures according to the conduct policies;
The detection of abusive patterns or misuse of the reservation system.

items.text: **7.1.** Notwithstanding the provisions in previous sections, the JOM Platform may, exceptionally and after evaluation, authorize full or partial refunds in duly justified cases.

list: Extraordinary circumstances or force majeure, such as natural events, government restrictions or unforeseen situations beyond the User's control;

Risks to the User's safety, detected by the Platform or reported through official channels;
Errors attributable to the Platform system that affect the correct management of the reservation.

items.text: **7.3.** The applicability of the refund will be subject to:

list: The verification of the facts;
The presentation of sufficient evidence by the User;

items.text: **8.1.** Every cancellation must be managed exclusively through the JOM Platform, using the mechanisms enabled for this purpose.

list: Make the cancellation within their account;

items.text: **8.3.** Once the cancellation is made:

faqs.question: Can I pay in cash upon arrival?
faqs.answer: No. All reservations are processed solely through the JOM platform for security and control. Paying via JOM guarantees that the host fulfills their part.
faqs.keywords: cash payment in person arrive reservation

faqs.question: What payment methods are available?
faqs.answer:
You can make your payment through the methods enabled by the JOM platform when making your reservation. We currently accept:
• QR payment from Bolivian entities.
• Bolivian and international credit or debit cards (Visa and MasterCard). To make the payment you must have your card enabled for online payments.
• Tigo Money.
faqs.keywords: payment methods qr credit debit card tigo money visa mastercard

faqs.question: Can I change the dates of my reservation?
faqs.answer: Of course! You can request a date change up to 5 days before check-in, always subject to availability.
faqs.keywords: change reservation dates modify check-in availability

faqs.question: What if I arrive later than the scheduled time?
faqs.answer: Check-in is coordinated in advance between the host and the guest to ensure everything is ready for your arrival. If for any reason you arrive later than expected, please inform the host in time. Maintaining good communication helps us provide you with a better experience and organize the service properly.
faqs.noticeInfo: You can chat via the message function on the platform, don't forget to enable notifications and check your email. If you connect via WhatsApp or call, consider that as long as you have the reservation on JOM we can support that the host meets your expectations. If you make reservations outside the platform, it is your responsibility.
faqs.keywords: arrive late schedule check-in coordination notice host

faqs.question: Can I extend my stay?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can request an extension as long as the property is available for the new dates. This can be easily managed online at jom.bo.
faqs.keywords: extend stay more days nights availability

faqs.question: Can I leave my bags before check-in or after check-out?
faqs.answer: It depends on availability and prior coordination. If possible, it will be for a limited time. This depends on each accommodation and host.
faqs.keywords: bags luggage store before after check-in check-out

faqs.question: How does check-out work?
faqs.answer:
The schedule and departure instructions can be found in the property guide. When leaving, we ask that you leave the accommodation in good condition. Basic recommendations:

cancellationOptions.title: CANCELLATION OPTIONS
cancellationOptions.intro: At JOM, hosts choose the cancellation policy that best fits their listing. Before booking, check which policy applies in the listing details section.

sections.title: 1. Flexible
list: Full refund: If you cancel up to 24 hours before check-in time (usually 3:00 PM local time).
If you cancel less than 24 hours in advance, the first night is non-refundable, but you will be refunded for the remaining nights.

sections.title: 2. Moderate
sections.content: A balance between flexibility and commitment.
list: Full refund: If you cancel up to 5 days before arrival.
Partial refund (50%): If you cancel after that period but before 24 hours of arrival.
No refund: If you cancel on the same day or do not show up.

sections.title: 3. Strict
list: Full refund: Only if you cancel within 48 hours of booking and at least 14 days before arrival.
50% Refund: If you cancel between 7 and 14 days before arrival.
No refund: If you cancel less than 7 days in advance.

sections.title: 4. Non-refundable
sections.content: Usually offers a lower price in exchange for a firm commitment.
list: No refunds will be given for cancellation at any time after booking confirmation, except if the cancellation is due to documented force majeure.

trustAndSafety.title: Trust & Safety
trustAndSafety.subtitle: Your safety is our priority. We have designed tools and processes so you can book and host with complete peace of mind.

sections.title: Verified Profiles
sections.content: Before booking or listing, we ask all users to verify their identity. This ensures that everyone on the platform is who they say they are.

sections.title: Real Reviews
sections.content: Reputation is everything. Only users who have completed a stay can leave a review. This ensures that the opinions you read are authentic and based on real experiences.
list: **Post-stay only.** Enabled after completing the stay.
**Two-way.** Both guests and hosts can leave a review.

sections.title: Community Standards
sections.content: We do not tolerate discrimination, harassment, or dangerous behavior. If something isn't right, our support team is available **24/7** to intervene and help you.
list: **Zero discrimination.** Everyone deserves to be treated with respect, regardless of their origin, gender, religion or orientation.
**Zero harassment.** Any form of harassment or inappropriate behavior can be reported and will be addressed immediately.
**Safe spaces.** Hosts must ensure that their properties meet basic safety standards.
**24/7 Support.** Our team is ready to intervene at any stage of the trip, every day of the year.
